title: Enter different Insulin types to data Input section of xdrip
body: When we add data to xdrip like how much insulin we use, can you have a drop down box allowing us to define the type of Insulins we are using?

comments.body: Hi..I consider this function is vital especially for T1 not having a pump or loop project..I use free + miaomiao and I do not intend to change them in the medium term..the predictions have not of meaning without a simulation of the slow insulin reaction "Levemir, lantus ..

Candelanaj, I absolutely agree. 
My Tresiba bolus lasts about 24 hours, and I need to know what will be its effect in the following hours. 
Pippo    :-)

something like you want is merged to master by the end of last year #1080.
So check it out and rise improvement requests if it doesn't fit your needs
As mentioned by @gruoner, a PR is merged to solve this issue. Hence, it can be marked as resolved and closed. I'm using this featue and it works great. :-)
An addition of Tresiba and Levemir (or a user-configurable entry) would be appreciated.
